questions.question: What is a social movement?
options: An organised, sustained collective effort to promote or resist social change
questions.explanation: A social movement is an organised, sustained collective effort by a group to promote or resist social change.

questions.question: What is "civil disobedience"?
options: Deliberate, nonviolent violation of a law considered unjust, accepting the consequences
questions.explanation: Civil disobedience is the deliberate, nonviolent breaking of an unjust law while accepting the legal consequences.

questions.question: Which figures are associated with nonviolent resistance and civil disobedience?
options: Thoreau, Gandhi and Martin Luther King Jr.
questions.explanation: Civil disobedience is associated with Henry David Thoreau, Mahatma Gandhi and Martin Luther King Jr.

questions.question: How was the Black Lives Matter movement founded?
options: By Garza, Cullors and Tometi after the acquittal in the Trayvon Martin case
questions.explanation: BLM was founded by Alicia Garza, Patrisse Cullors and Opal Tometi after the acquittal of George Zimmerman.

questions.question: What is "hashtag activism"?
options: Using social media hashtags to raise awareness and build movements
questions.explanation: Hashtag activism uses social media hashtags (#BlackLivesMatter, #MeToo, #FridaysForFuture) to raise awareness and mobilise.
